taxi.rules: Tokyo 23 wards (fare revision ~20 Apr 2026, +10%): ¥500 for first 1.0 km, then ¥100 per 232 m; time charge ~¥100 per ~1.5 min when below 10 km/h; late-night surcharge +20% from 22:00 to 05:00; expressway tolls extra. Older 1.096 km / 255 m figures are outdated.
taxi.estimates_note: ESTIMATES: road km approximate, fares computed from the 2026 tariff + time charge + 20% night surcharge, no tolls. Fri late night demand is high; app prices may show a fixed fare or surge.
taxi.apps: GO (largest fleet in Tokyo, works with foreign cards, English UI), Uber (dispatches licensed Tokyo taxis; prices can be higher), S.RIDE (Sony/Tokyo taxi groups). Street hail works anywhere: red 空車 sign = free. Roppongi crossing and Tokyo Midtown/Roppongi Hills taxi stands are the easiest pickup points late night.

walks.note: ~1 km downhill via Imoarai-zaka or past Roppongi Hills, approx
Hibiya line station is on the Showa-dori side, ~300 m from JR Electric Town exit, approx

warnings.text: US State Department: exercise caution in nightlife districts, especially Roppongi, Kabuki-cho, Shibuya, Ikebukuro. Reported pattern: drink spiking, then large fraudulent credit-card charges, sometimes forced ATM withdrawals or violence. Do not follow street touts (catch / 客引き) into bars; do not accept drinks from strangers; watch your drink; carry one card and limited cash.
warnings.source: travel.state.gov Japan country page https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/international-travel/International-Travel-Country-Information-Pages/Japan.html ; US Embassy Tokyo alerts 2009/2015 (via https://www.ttgasia.com/2015/06/10/us-cautions-its-travellers-on-visiting-tokyos-roppongi-kabuki-cho/)

warnings.text: Clubs: legal drinking age 20; door ID check is standard. Bring ORIGINAL passport (photocopy and foreign driving licence often refused; residence card OK for residents). Some venues apply informal 23+/25+ or dress-code policies at the door.
Foreigners must carry passport (or residence card) at all times under Japanese law; police may ask for it in Roppongi.
warnings.source: Immigration Control Act, general rule (not re-verified this session)
